decision: Selected the footprint centroid of the Bavarian LoD2 building whose official address is 'Deutschherrnstraße 15,17', Nürnberg, as the reviewed site locator. noris network gives Deutschherrnstraße 15–19, 90429 Nürnberg as the address of its Nürnberg Zentrum data centres (NBG2, NBG3, NBG4), and the DQS EN 50600 certificate scopes 'Rechenzentrum Nürnberg Mitte, Deutschherrnstraße 15-19'. The other address buildings of the range (No. 15a and No. 19) and two adjoining unaddressed buildings are recorded but not used for the point.
source_integrity: Tile size 137,407,037 bytes and SHA-256 equal the values listed for 648_5478.gml in the official LDBV metalink (geodaten.bayern.de/odd/a/lod2/citygml/meta/metalink/09.meta4, captured 7 November 2026).

selected_properties.query: Tile 648_5478 holds 6,472 buildings. Its Deutschherrnstraße addresses are 3, 4, 4a, 6, 15,17, 15a, 19, 27, 29, 31, 37, 39 and 47a, each on exactly one building; the adjoining tile 648_5480 holds only Nos. 8, 10, 43, 45, 47, 49, 50 and 51. Exactly one building carries Nos. 15 and 17 (DEBY_LOD2_3334460), one No. 15a (DEBY_LOD2_3334459) and one No. 19 (DEBY_LOD2_3335277).

identity_bridge: noris network locations page (version modified 7 September 2026): 'Nürnberg Zentrum — noris network AG, Deutschherrnstraße 15–19, 90429 Nürnberg'.

DQS certificate 358515 KB (valid 1 October 2024 to 30 September 2027), linked from the operator's Nuremberg Center page: EN 50600 implemented in the 'Rechenzentrum Nürnberg Mitte', scope 'Deutschherrnstraße 15-19, 90429 Nürnberg', availability class 3 of 4.

noris network Nuremberg Center page (sitemap lastmod 6 November 2026): three data centres NBG2, NBG3 and NBG4 in the centre of Nuremberg, 0.8 km from the Plärrer underground station, with parking in the courtyard and ground-level delivery.

Bavarian LoD2: the address range 15–19 maps to three address buildings in tile 648_5478 (Nos. 15,17; 15a; 19), all commercial buildings (function 31001_2000) on the south side of Deutschherrnstraße in Nürnberg (Gemeindeschlüssel 09564000).

consistency_checks.parcel_map: The official ALKIS Parzellarkarte (rendered 7 November 2026) labels house numbers 19, 15/17 and 15a on the contiguous building group on the south side of Deutschherrnstraße between Solgerstraße and the next building to the east; No. 19 is the long street-front block, Nos. 15/17 the block at its eastern end and No. 15a the building behind it.
consistency_checks.orthophoto: The official DOP40 orthophoto (flight 13 June 2025, image 125026) shows the same group: a long light-roofed street-front block (No. 19) with an inner courtyard behind it, and at its eastern end the taller block of Nos. 15/17 with a distinctive green-blue roof. The image does not show which rooms hold the data centres; it is identity context only, not an independent imagery verification.
consistency_checks.distance_check: The operator's directions (0.8 km from the Plärrer underground station, inner-city location) were not used to derive or test the point; the point rests only on the official address building. Within LoD2 tiles 648_5478 and 648_5480, Deutschherrnstraße Nos. 15, 15a, 17 and 19 occur only in the group described.

transform_check: pyproj EPSG:25832 -> EPSG:4326, always_xy; inverse round trip of the rounded point 0.004 m.
excluded_coordinates: The operator's locations page embeds a Google Maps placeholder; it was not unlocked, resolved or read, and no map-service coordinates were used.
